name: Bruno Santamaría Razo
bio: Born in Mexico City. Cinematographer and documentary director, graduated from the Cinematographic Training Center. Her first film, Margarita, presents an intimate look that is constant in her work, such as The best thing you can do with your life, Vivos and Artemio. His work has been shown at the Berlinale, Hot Docs, FIPA, Sheffield Doc Fest, Camerimage, FICG and FICM.
